roleDescriptions.overwhelm: The attack’s damage and other effects can't be blocked by a weapon/shield or mitigated. If the attached damage call contains any other effects, the strike must hit a valid location required by that effect (if any).
roleDescriptions.break: If this effect strikes a weapon or shield, the struck item becomes broken and can't be used until it's fixed with the Repair skill or another effect. If it strikes a limb, this effect acts as a Maim effect instead.
roleDescriptions.charm: For the next 10 minutes (or the stated time), you must follow the orders of the character who used this effect on you, following the spirit of the order rather than its literal meaning. Your character doesn't have to reveal secrets they don't want to, and can remain silent instead of lying, omitting details, or using wordplay to get around the order. You can refuse to follow an order that makes you uncomfortable OOG, after informing the player that you're doing so.
roleDescriptions.command: You must follow one order given to you by the character who used this effect on you, following the spirit of the order rather than its literal meaning. This effect ends if you haven't completed the ordered action within 60 seconds. You can refuse to follow an order that makes you uncomfortable OOG, after informing the player that you're doing so.
roleDescriptions.daze: You can't use Active skills, Active abilities, or items for the next 10 minutes. A subsequent successful Daze effect restarts the 10-minute period.
roleDescriptions.disarm: If this effect strikes a weapon or shield, you must drop the struck item and can't pick it up again for the next 10 seconds. If it strikes a limb, you must drop any non-weapon item you're holding with that limb (including a person you're moving with the Carry basic action) and can't pick it up again for the next 10 seconds.
roleDescriptions.fear: For the next 1 minute, you must stay at least 10 steps away from the character who used this effect on you. You can't attack them, or use skills, abilities, or items on them.
roleDescriptions.knockdown: You must drop to your knees or rear for the next 10 seconds, starting once your knees or rear touch the ground. You can't use Active skills from the Defensive Discipline during this time, but can otherwise function as normal.
roleDescriptions.knockout: For the next 10 minutes, you're unconscious, putting you into the Helpless state. You can't call out when struck, immediately fall to the ground, and can't move, fight, or talk for the duration -- you're unaware of anything that happens around or to you. Another character can end the effect early by spending 30 seconds of roleplay shaking you awake, or by dealing at least 1 point of damage to your Flesh.
roleDescriptions.maim: If this effect strikes a limb, that limb becomes maimed until it's fixed. A maimed arm must hang limp at your side and can't grip items. A maimed leg can't bear weight -- with one leg maimed you can drag it and move at a slow walk, but can't run or hop; with both legs maimed you immediately fall to the ground and can move only via a crawl that doesn't use your legs, though another character can move you with the Carry basic action.
roleDescriptions.pin: If this effect strikes a leg, that leg's foot is pinned in place and can't move, though you can pivot on it. A character with the Medical Assistant skill can spend 30 seconds of roleplay removing the restraining object, or you can pull your own pinned leg free with a 3-count ("Pulling Free 1, 2, 3"), which deals 4 points of unmitigable Flesh damage.
roleDescriptions.rage: For the next 1 minute, you must attack the character closest to you; this effect ends early if you enter the Dying state. If you don't have a weapon, retrieve an unattended one within easy reach and start attacking -- if none are available, roleplay a powerful expression of verbal rage.
roleDescriptions.slam: For the next 10 seconds, you can't take offensive actions such as attacking, can't block with your shield and must hang your shield arm at your side, can only move at a walking pace, and must roleplay being disoriented. A strike carrying the Slam effect can't be blocked -- you always take its full numerical damage and effects.
roleDescriptions.slay: Your armour becomes broken, and your current Flesh total is set to -1, putting you in the Dying state.
roleDescriptions.stun: For the next 1 minute, you must freeze in place, putting you into the Helpless state. You can't move or speak, but remain aware of your surroundings. Another character can end the effect early by spending 30 seconds of roleplay shaking you awake, or by dealing at least 1 point of damage to your Flesh.
roleDescriptions.full-auto: When firing a gun item with the Full Auto trait, it deals damage at a rate faster than once per second. Each shot you fire while in the Full Auto state deals damage to the character it hits. Each shot is considered a separate attack for the purposes of defensive effects.
roleDescriptions.amount: How much numerical damage the call deals.
roleDescriptions.damage-type: The type of damage that the call deals.
roleDescriptions.drain-amount: How much is drained. Start of a Drain Damage Type.
roleDescriptions.drain-resource: The resource being drained. Middle of a Drain Damage Type.
roleDescriptions.drain: End of a Drain Damage Type.
roleDescriptions.mitigate: You mitigate a single effect or damage call made against you.
roleDescriptions.parry: You mitigate the effect portion of a single damage call made against you.
roleDescriptions.phase-out: Call “Phase Out” and go OOG by placing your hand on your head. You’re considered OOG during this time. You aren’t aware of your surroundings. Any timed effects affecting you are paused during this time (unless otherwise noted).
roleDescriptions.phase-in: Once you’ve fulfilled the conditions specified by the skill, ability, or item that granted you this effect, call “Phase In” and remove the hand from your head to come back IG.
roleDescriptions.sacrifice: You mitigate a successful strike made against another character, and take all numerical damage and effects of that strike instead. You can then call a second mitigation effect to mitigate that strike.
roleDescriptions.shrug-off: You mitigate the numerical portion of a single damage call made against you.
roleDescriptions.withstand: You fully mitigate a single damage call. Your current Flesh total is set to 1. Your worn armour becomes broken, and your Natural Armour Value is reduced to 0.
roleDescriptions.defense-name: Which Defense is being spent. The rulebook’s list of Defense names isn’t complete, so any word is accepted here.
roleDescriptions.unknown: This doesn't fit into the call as written. It may be an unknown word, or a real one in the wrong place.
